description: Playback recovery release for the stall and missing-badge regression reported in 2.0.9.

changelog.title: Vox 2.0.10
items: Playback recovery release for the stall and missing-badge regression reported in 2.0.9.

changelog.title: Playback
items: **Fallback chain now actually runs.** When the primary InnerTube request threw (HTTP failure, parse failure, or a rejected client version), the whole resolution aborted before any fallback client was tried. That left ExoPlayer with no stream, and the quality badge vanished because no format was ever recorded. A failed primary request is now treated as a failed attempt: the resolver seeds its response from the first fallback client that answers, then continues down the existing chain.

**Tidal-only no longer blocks unconfigured devices.** `TIDAL_ONLY` used to fail every track outright. It now fails hard only when Tidal can actually answer (a logged-in session or a user-supplied proxy). Otherwise it logs a warning and falls back to InnerTube.
Primary client order is unchanged. `ANDROID_VR` remains first for speed and format coverage, with `IOS` and the rest of the chain available when it does not answer.

changelog.title: Notes
items: Badge recovery depends on resolution succeeding; it is the same code path and has no separate fix.
Verified locally with `:app:compileUniversalFossDebugKotlin`. Device playback and the DASH path are not verified in this release.

If playback still fails after this build, capture `adb logcat -s YTPlayerUtils PlaybackLogManager` while tapping a song; the log now states which client seeded the response and where the chain stopped.
